closed_since_last_record: TR/M base thread depth: M6 x 1.0, 8.6 mm deep
TR/M setscrew engagement: M4 x 0.7 stud standing 4.6-5.2 mm out of the post
PH50/M bore: 12.8 mm diameter, 43.2 mm deep, for TR-series posts
PH50/M base thread: M6 x 1.0 tapped thru
BA2/M slot and counterbore geometry for M6 cap screws
missing: a breadboard product identity: no optical table is in the 33-preset inventory, so the bottom of the chain has no product yet
manufacturing tolerances: every drawing is stamped FOR INFORMATION ONLY and states none, so fit classes and tolerance stacks stay out of reach

interface datums still have to be AUTHORED from these drawings and checked against the STEP model: two dimensions (TR/M side bore at 10.2 mm, PH50/M thumbscrew at 12.7 mm) were read off dimension lines rather than stated in words
support_blockers.next_action: Pick the breadboard product, then build schema v1 records with frames for TR50/M, PH50/M and BA2/M from these facts and check every critical dimension against an independent mesh measurement, which is stage 05's exit condition.
